name: Hello World
tagline: Hello World web server in under 2 MB
description:
# Hello World
Tiny app that prints "Hello World" in the browser. Can be used to test the deployment of a new app.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  hello-world:
    container_name: hello-world
    image: crccheck/hello-world:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - ${APP_PORT}:8000
